design_parameters.enrich_notes: Excerpts are IDOT highway drainage policy (Ch 1–2, 6–9, 12) and storm-sewer utility separation, not site SCM sizing. Chapter 12 defines detention vs retention and linear oversizing; BMP list (8-306) points to Illinois Urban Manual and BDE Ch 59 for BMP design. Roadside ditch minimum longitudinal grade 0.3% (0.4–0.6% preferred) applies to ditches, not explicitly to vegetated swales. Floodplain storage excavation cites 1 ft minimum above groundwater/normal pool (3-403.01)—not SHWT separation for infiltration SCMs.
